what: On the white curtain, a 1px progress line along the top fills from the left over 2s, and the center logo rises from below its mask over 1s after .5s. At 2s the line clears to the right over 1s as the logo blurs upward by 5rem, and at 3s the curtain folds away vertically around its top-right corner over 1s. All curves are cubic-bezier(.275,0,0,1). Hidden at 5s, then fx:done

options.hide: When the panel is hidden and fx:done fires (s), default 5
options.--fx-logo-at: When the logo starts rising, default .5s
options.--fx-out-at: When the lines clear and the logo fades, default 2s
options.--fx-dur: Rise, retract and fold duration, default 1s
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Center logo cell — the first child rises from below (without it, only the line and curtain)

note: The curtain’s fold axis is top right, so it lifts away starting from the top-right corner as the bottom edge rises. On frequently opened screens, shorten the --fx-* lengths

from.where: index.html #loading — original body.load: :before scale(1,0) 1s 3s (origin right top) · .progress width 1s 2s · .progress:before width 2s · .logo opacity·margin-top -5rem 1s 2s · .logo img translateY(100%)→0 1s .5s, curve cubic-bezier(.275,0,0,1), first section starts at 4s, #loading hidden at 5s
